entities.summary: Muhammad Irfan Sr. is a Pakistani field hockey player who plays as a defender for the Pakistan national team. He was a member of the Pakistan team at the 2010 Commonwealth Games in New Delhi, India. He has played in the 2010 World Cup and was selected for the 2018 World Cup. He also represented Pakistan at the 2012 Summer Olympics. He also played for Pakistan in the 2011 and 2014 Champions Trophy events. In 2010, Irfan faced a three-game suspension for pushing a South African player.
